data.desc: Globus is an integrated dry bulk shipping company that provides marine transportation services worldwide and presently owns, operates and manages a fleet of ten dry bulk vessels that transport iron ore, coal, grain, steel products, cement, alumina and other dry bulk cargoes internationally. Globus' subsidiaries own and operate ten vessels with a total carrying capacity of approximately 744,622DWT and a weighted average age of about 8 years as of September 14, 2026.
